planner.warning: Appending only at function end misses active corner passes; the explicit return is the normal nonempty-pass path.

freshness.conservativeRule: Completed planner pass, sampleIndex between -1 and nodeCount-2 inclusive, all8 marker bytes interpreted signed between0 and nodeCount-1, all5 XY and distance values finite. Otherwise preserve raw record but report unknown/partial, never fresh complete geometry.
freshness.limitation: Producer completion alone does not prove every XY was freshly sampled; the source sampler has early no-write returns. Rolling window remains partial event coverage.

committedPages.check: Validate unsigned nonzero bounded span and every covered16KiB page, not only endpoints. No commit calls are needed or permitted for a read-only capture.

mailbox.bootProof: Exact23307 calls22068(0xd00000,0x10000), then memory.fill(0xd00000,0,0x10000); requested interval lies wholly inside this committed/zeroed scratch block.
mailbox.sourceAudit: No declared native owner in requested interval found in runtime sources; all direct integer/memory-offset references in exact module show none in requested interval.
reservationConditions: Pin exact module hash and refuse unsupported builds
Require whole interval zero before first claim, or exact current module/memory/generation ownership thereafter
Guard all mailbox writes inside the interval and validate current committed page
Use a single request/ack publication protocol and stale-generation rejection
Do not regard absence of direct references as universal proof against arbitrary computed pointer writes; never reuse this gap across other module hashes without audit
mailbox.memoryGrowWarning: memory.grow alone does not reserve ownership against runtime sbrk. Do not copy the full-tuner allocation pattern without an allocator reservation proof.

verificationScope: Static exact-module and retail disassembly inspection. No live capture/gameplay, native world execution, production/candidate code edits, or control/GPS changes.
